Priya: Hey team — quick favor. I need to take PTO Sunday and won't be able to cover the overnight shift starting Sat 22:00. Anyone able to swap or pick up Sat night (22:00-06:00)? I can trade for a weekday evening next week. :pleading_face:

Ken: I can take Sat night if someone covers my Sun morning (06:00-14:00). Prefer to avoid extra weekend stuff but I can flex.

Alex: I can do Sun night (22:00-06:00) if Ken picks Sun morning. That keeps things symmetric. :thumbsup:

Priya: Awesome, thanks @Ken and @Alex. If that works, can one of you update the rota and the calendar invite? Here's the links: https://calendar.company.com/rotations and runbook: https://internal/runbooks/oncall.md

Ken: Will do — updating rota now.

oncall-bot: Calendar updated — Priya removed from Sat 22:00-06:00, Ken added for Sat 22:00-06:00. Reminder set 1h before shift.

Maya: Quick FYI for whoever picks up Sat night: there's a scheduled DB maintenance Sat 23:00-23:30 in staging (not prod). Should be low-risk but watch the job queue around 23:00.

Sam: Heads-up on a small flakiness seen after the last canary deploy — healthcheck on inference-worker occasionally returns 502 for ~30s. If you see alerts, first step is to drain the pod and roll it: 

```
kubectl cordon <pod>
kubectl delete pod <pod> --namespace=infra
# or: kubectl rollout restart deploy/inference-worker -n infra
```

Also check logs: /var/log/inference/worker.log and the canary tag in the deploy dashboard.

Priya: Handoff notes before I go:
- No open PagerDuty alerts at the moment.
- Recent deploy: canary-1 rolled 09:20, no regressions seen.
- Known risk: batcher queue for model/large can spike ~80k tokens; mitigation is to scale worker-group inference-a by +2 replicas: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-a --replicas=5 -n infra`
- If DB jobs pile up, pause the nightly backfill (runbook link above).

Ken: Got the rota updated and pinged calendar attendees. I'll take Sat night and Alex will take Sun night as agreed. Leaving a note in the runbook tags. :white_check_mark:

Alex: Thanks — I'll cover Sun night. If something urgent pops, call/text me (cell +1-555-0102). Otherwise I'll check the channel before I start. :wave:

Priya: Thank you everyone, really appreciate the help. I'll set an out-of-office and leave my handoff doc in the oncall folder. Back online Monday morning. :heart:
